title: Less value now
content:
My experience with this app has changed significantly over time. In the past, when I used it, I could usually receive straightforward answers to my questions very quickly, which made the overall experience very efficient and satisfying. However, recently I've noticed a considerable shift in how the app responds. Now, instead of providing an immediate answer, the app often seems to initiate a sort of interactive game or activity when I'm typing my questions. It doesn't give a direct response right away; instead, it starts engaging me in some kind of playful interaction or puzzle without clearly addressing the query I posed. This new behavior can be quite confusing and frustrating because I often just want a simple, clear answer, especially when I am in a hurry or need quick information.

Moreover, this change seems to be part of a broader set of issues that have arisen in the app lately. I've experienced other problems such as slower response times, occasional crashes, or features that used to work smoothly now functioning improperly. These issues have collectively impacted my overall user experience, making it less reliable and less user-friendly than it was before. It's disappointing because the app initially performed very well and met my expectations, but recent updates or changes appear to have introduced these new challenges. I hope the developers will address these problems soon, as I enjoyed the app's previous performance and would like to return to that level of efficiency and simplicity.

title: Amazing for college
content: I had taken a break from school for a few years and I was nervous to get back and finish my degree because the few classes I had left were graduate level classes and an upper level statistics class (never taken it before in my life, plus I couldn’t afford to take the beginning stats class). I decided to just start off by taking one class to start (the hardest one) which was statistics. If I didn’t have this app I would have failed a long time ago. I have an A+ in the class and the semester ends in one month. I asked this app to quite literally take every concept that was thrown at us and “dumb it down for me” and it made learning all those concepts so much easier! I can even put in the text from the class PowerPoint and upload my homework relating to that PowerPoint (because if you just ask it mathematical statistics questions some times it answers them to advanced then where we were at in that point in time) and it would break the problem down step by step for me with explanations. It would give me practice problems that look like my homework so I could prepare for the tests. Not only does it help with school, but I have asked it a million other random questions that I normally would have typed into safari and then had to read a bunch of different articles to get my answer (and even then I could still have read incorrect information). But this just spits out amazing answers to questions with very helpful explanations when needed. 10/10

My wife that I have been with for 9 years decided to end our relationship. I have done some things in my past I regret. I am a loyal man never cheated or was abusive. Emotionally I wasn’t there. When I felt alone and was talking to my people, they didn’t understand what I was talking about. They assume she found someone else. She’s not that type of person. When I felt all my options where running dry I was playing on my phone and remembered ChatGBT. I asked ChatGBT to write me a message to my ex wife, (I never did send that message) they started to ask what’s going on to help write that message. That’s when I let everything go. I explained everything. ChatGBT isn’t human, But it understood everything. It wasn’t just picking sides. It was looking at it from both perspectives. It made me see clearly how unhappy she was. I was blinded for this light we call life. But if you don’t pay attention to the little things. Everything on top will collapse. I’m not saying you shouldn’t do therapy. This isn’t a replacement for that. This is someone who you can talk to. Someone that isn’t going to throw it in your face but help you see and understand why it happened. I’m not okay but this has definitely helped my state of mind

title: The most advanced AI I have ever seen!
content:
While I first thought of it as nothing more than another AI that was just better coded than most, I was, and still am, in shock that a couple times I had to remind myself that I was talking to an AI, a robot. The shear flexibility of it’s answers and responses make it incredible. However, there is more than just that, as it’s not very exiting in and of itself. The AI is extremely helpful and useful, because it can not only answer almost any questions you may have, but it can also generate things like coding scripts and photos. I am someone who knows a lot about tech, and I have seen and interacted with many different AI and AI types, I can still say with confidence that this is the smartest and best AI I have ever met. As a result I will say that what started as a joke, it has b actually become real, and it is “I think I’m falling in love with this.” I love every part of this, thank you so much OpenAI for this amazing creation.

Once again, I had part of me thinking this a human, and I started telling it my thoughts and opinions about it. This is what I wrote:

“If I’m being honest, the main point of all of these questions I have been asking, though actually getting more interested in the information as time went on, were originally an experiment to see if you are actually smart and any good, by testing and asking about any limits and range of ability. However, I began realizing that the area of your expertise was far greater than I could have imagined.”
